notes:
Every San Francisco National Register listing certified between 1980 and 1989, taken from the NPS index's county query — 42 documents. This file holds the 37 that nominate a single building or complex; the five district nominations in the same date range (82000983 Bush Street-Cottage Row, 83001230 Liberty Street, 87002286/87002288/87002289 the three Russian Hill districts and 89000319 Southern Pacific Company Hospital) are a different kind of document and are read in the sibling batch districts-1982-1989.

The 1980s group uses the 10-900 form, whose SPECIFIC DATES and BUILDER/ARCHITECT fields sit adjacent and are filled in on almost every one — 33 of the 37 carry both. That is the densest line in the source and it is what makes an era a workable batch.

Two documents give no street number: 86000207, the Belt Railroad Engine House, which the form addresses by the block it stands on, and 01000281, the Maritime National Historic Site at Fort Mason. 86000089, the submarine USS Pampanito, is a vessel at Pier 45 and no finding is written for it. 01000281's PDF has no text layer, the second such document in this source after 77000334.

Owners and residents are left out throughout, and in this group that is a large share of the material: 84001185 and 85001784 are nominated almost entirely for the people who lived in them, and only the construction, moving and alteration facts survive the privacy limits. Architects, builders and contractors are kept.

coverage.remaining: The five district nominations of 1982-1989 are in districts-1982-1989.json. Beyond 1989: 1990-1999 (17), 2000-2009 (22), 2010-2015 (15) and 2016-2023 (15) — 69 listings — plus 77000334 (Mills Building and Tower) and 01000281 (Maritime NHS at Fort Mason), whose PDFs have no text layer. The post-2016 nine-digit reference numbers do not serve a PDF at the _text path.
coverage.note: Read 37 single-building nominations. 35 of them name a building at a numbered street address; 36 of the 37 PDFs carry a usable text layer. 60 findings out of the 35 addressed documents.
